source: Written for the corpus: references announced the way preachers usually say them.

segments.text: Good morning church, please be seated.
This morning we are going to be in the book of Romans chapter 8.
Turn with me to John chapter 3, verse 16.
Second Timothy chapter three, verses sixteen and seventeen.
Psalm one hundred and nineteen, verse one hundred and five.
Isaiah 40 verse 31, they that wait upon the Lord.
Turn in your Bibles to the book of Jonah.
Hebrews chapter 11 verse 1, now faith is the substance of things hoped for.
Lamentations chapter three, verse twenty two.
Our reading is from Proverbs 3 verses 5 and 6.
Revelation 21:4, he will wipe away every tear.
